_comment: Interactives that open a document when clicked: posters, books, plaques.
The client shows them with a kkt that only carries the document's id; neither title nor text
travel, the client has them in its own documents table (dofus3_data/documents.json). Measured in
every reading of the captures: the client sends iwo, the server answers iwn { 1, element, 184,
character } and kkt { f2: document }, and the close button's kla gets the empty kld.
A document whose text links a quest ('event:startquest,1633') starts it with the client's ido
{ f1: quest }: the job offer of the Incarnam tavern does exactly that in 'mision matarratas
completa'. A row may still ask a question of its own (question/accept/decline): the reply that
accepts is what records having read it.
Reading one is noted down in CharacterElements like any other interactive use, and from there
comes the afterElement condition of the NPCs' replies.

readables.why: The job offer of the Incarnam tavern, measured in 'mision matarratas completa': iwo on element 489412, iwn with skill 184, kkt 420, and the client's ido { 1633 } from the document's link starts «Matarratas». No question: the earlier one, with 27068 «Aceptar la oferta.», was ours and the capture has none.
The same sign on the adjacent map [1,-3]: the client's data puts element 489412 on both, the building spans them.
